sloka: स भोजनं वसिष्ठाय पत्न्या सार्धमुपाहरत् ।मदयन्त्या नरव्याघ्र सामिषं रक्षसा हृतम् ।। ७.६५.२६ ॥
transliteration: sa bhojanaṁ vasiṣṭhāya patnyā sārdhamupāharat ।madayantyā naravyāghra sāmiṣaṁ rakṣasā hṛtam ।। 7.65.26 ॥

translations.english: O tiger among men, he (the king) offered that meal, which was prepared with meat by the demon, to Vasistha along with his wife Madayanti.
